cohort: 3578 patients achieving cumulative singleton clinical pregnancy after their first oocytes retrieval cycle
finding: Down-regulation with serum estradiol levels <30 pg/ml may have advantages regarding lower risks of both maternal hypertension and newborn PICU admission, while down-regulation with serum estradiol levels 30-55 pg/ml may be associated with low birth weight in patients with relatively low quality embryos.
mod_finding: Patients with low serum estradiol after down-regulation (<30 pg/ml) may have a lower risk of delivering a low birth weight infant via fresh transfer + frozen transfer(s) compared to those with estradiol levels between 30-55 pg/ml.
